source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: A possessive clause with a dative possessor is derived as in (41). Starting from an initial structure in which the existential copula baar merges with a possessive DP as its external argument13, LocP is merged with this initial structure. The possessor raises to Spec,LocP where it receives a dative case feature which, upon spellout, will be spelled out with the help of the dative case marker resulting in ejiexe ‘you-dative’.
